subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's qa-matrix package deletion, reusable Matrix QA workflow secret handling, and additive QA runner adapter contract after fixing the AGENTS formatting?
rationale: Dependency graph ownership, secret-bearing workflow behavior, and plugin SDK contract shape are maintainer/security decisions that source inspection cannot safely settle alone.

options.title: Fix formatting and approve exact head
options.body: Repair the AGENTS indentation, then have authorized owners approve the dependency graph, workflow secret boundary, and SDK surface on the reviewed head before merge.

options.title: Split risky surfaces
options.body: Move reusable workflow routing or the QA runner adapter contract change into smaller owner-reviewed follow-up PRs if maintainers want a narrower qa-matrix retirement diff.

options.title: Pause the retirement
options.body: Keep this PR draft until maintainers are ready to own the package deletion and release QA workflow change together.

recommendation.title: Fix formatting and approve exact head
recommendation.body: Repair the AGENTS indentation, then have authorized owners approve the dependency graph, workflow secret boundary, and SDK surface on the reviewed head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA live workflow and qa-matrix history makes this the best available owner for the approval choice.
